ext_description.message: Paste a link, get a timestamped summary — YouTube, podcasts, articles. Free (your own Gemini API key).

url_placeholder.message: YouTube, podcast RSS, Apple Podcasts, article…

status_done.message: Done — opened in a new tab.

api_key_hint.message: Free, no card required — get one at ai.google.dev.

error_no_result.message: No result ID in the URL.

footer_note.message: Works for YouTube, podcast RSS/Apple Podcasts feeds with a transcript tag, and article pages. Summarizing needs a free Gemini API key (see Settings below) — no cost, no card.
